column3: [imports] test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/10340_r613y_dependency_dotted_prefix_package_false.py: the local module test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/multi_file_lib/r613y/X2/r613y_depv2.py, which the program reaches, imports `zpy61` absolutely: resolved from its own directory (how its contracts are verified) that is test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/multi_file_lib/r613y/X2/zpy61/__init__.py, but CPython resolves it through the PROGRAM's sys.path (the program's directory first, then PYTHONPATH / --import-path), where it is test-suite/corpus/pycsl-reference/zpy61/__init__.py, so the contracts pycsl would believe describe another module than the one the program runs (review rt72 A1: prog.py -> lib/dep.py -> `from zqh72 import one`; pycsl PROVED `\result == 1` with lib/zqh72.py, CPython loaded the program directory's zqh72.py and printed 2). FIX: import the module package-relatively (`from . import ...`) or by its full package path, or rename one of the two files so that both resolutions agree.

FIX: rename the package (or the module) so that one root holds the whole dotted path.
